# data/external

Auxiliary or external reference layers that are **not** the primary/benchmark datasets — e.g.
authoritative reference masks, land-cover layers, or field-reference evidence used for independent
acceptance (AC-3) in later milestones. **Contents are git-ignored** (only this README is tracked).

Anything placed here must be recorded in `data/manifests/datasets.yaml` (or an extension of it) with full
provenance and licence before use.
